goal: Provide an upstream implementation and test harness for BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules
Fixes known consensus vulnerabilities like quadratic sigops and Merkle collisions on regtest
Allows developers to evaluate and prepare the soft fork without activating on mainnet
agreement: Strong support with extensive concept approval and testing across contributors
Verified consensus logic and killed activation mutants with mutation testing (instagibbs, ViniciusCestarii)
Verified sigop counting, sizes, and vectors against btclib and the BIP specification (fametrano)
Open suggestions ask for minor test additions and clarification on cache edge cases (ariard, fametrano)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it addresses known consensus flaws like CPU exhaustion and 64-byte tx collisions
Impact is less urgent because the rules are only active on regtest and inactive on mainnet
High strategic importance for testing and evaluating the consensus cleanup soft fork upstream
